observedCapabilities: explicit edit markers with editor handle and edit time to second

pitSemantics.firstKnownRule: Use capturedAt as conservative system-observable time. Source-stated post/comment/edit times are provenance and may not backdate system observability before the first successful capture.
pitSemantics.versionRule: Each later snapshot is append-only with capture fingerprint. Never rewrite a prior snapshot; disappearance or modification after an earlier snapshot becomes a new version state.
pitSemantics.deletionRule: If content disappears before first capture, historical state is UNKNOWN. If it disappears after a captured version, preserve prior version and append deletion/unavailable state.
pitSemantics.actorIdentityRule: PTT handle is a public forum actor identifier only, not verified brokerage investor identity.
pitSemantics.commentClockPrecision: Observed comment clock is minute-level on article pages; do not invent seconds.
pitSemantics.articleClockPrecision: Observed article publication and edit markers can be second-level where exposed.

ownershipFirewall.D20-11: Owns topic/phrase/stance/narrative diffusion across posts, replies, authors and time.
ownershipFirewall.D20-06: Owns social-herding/leader-follower transforms only when sequential stance convergence is identified after common-news/topic controls.
ownershipFirewall.sharedPrimitiveRule: One PTT source receipt may feed both transforms but cannot create two independent selection votes.
ownershipFirewall.D20-07: Attention/salience controls may consume post/reply volume, but raw volume cannot be counted again as an independent behavioral vote.
ownershipFirewall.D17: News/event source remains canonical owner of underlying news/event facts; copied headlines are not independent narrative evidence.
